# Vendored rpi-rgb-led-matrix

This directory contains the subset of
[`hzeller/rpi-rgb-led-matrix`](https://github.com/hzeller/rpi-rgb-led-matrix)
required by RetroArch's HUB75 video driver.

- Upstream commit: `d7eef803089d49606c9a22170cbd8bd6c97dc2a3`
- Upstream date: 2026-07-21
- License: GPL-2.0-or-later (see `COPYING` and the upstream `README.md`)

The vendored subset consists of the public headers, the static-library
sources, the Raspberry Pi 5 RP1 PIO/RIO backend, and upstream build metadata.
Examples, language bindings, fonts, utilities, and documentation images are
not required by RetroArch and are intentionally omitted.
